name: @stealthbridge/sdk
description: StealthBridge read-only client and contracts spec for early testnet integration

scripts.check:version: node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("package.json","utf8"));const semver=/^(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)(?:-((?:0|[1-9]\d*|\d*[a-zA-Z-][0-9a-zA-Z-]*)(?:\.(?:0|[1-9]\d*|\d*[a-zA-Z-][0-9a-zA-Z-]*))*))?(?:\+([0-9a-zA-Z-]+(?:\.[0-9a-zA-Z-]+)*))?$/;if(!pkg.version||!semver.test(pkg.version)){console.error(`Invalid SemVer: ${pkg.version}`);process.exit(1);}if(process.env.GITHUB_REF&&process.env.GITHUB_REF.startsWith("refs/tags/v")){const tag=process.env.GITHUB_REF.replace(/^refs\/tags\/v/,"");if(tag!==pkg.version){console.error(`Version mismatch: tag v${tag} !== package.json ${pkg.version}`);process.exit(1);}}console.log(`SDK version verified: ${pkg.name}@${pkg.version}`);'
scripts.verify: npm run check:version && npm run typecheck && npm test
